snippet.title: Studs Up! | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Studs Up! is a first-person football game where you control your feet. Play 1v1 to 5v5 online as a striker, keeper or referee. Have no friends? Draft a squad in the 'Cup Run' roguelite mode. Level up your players, pick upgrades and fight through a knockout cup.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4923370/Studs_Up/
Discord: discord.gg/xdtNPEuda2
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dextragames/
